runtimeCodeBudget.measurement: linked CODE + STARFIELD + BROADSIDE + A2_KERNEL + ENTITY_CODE bytes

runtimeTiming.method: NMOS-6502 execution of linked release bytes with replayed legal gameplay sessions

estimatedAdditive.classification: diagnostic estimate only; not a measured PAL frame or physical headroom

threeBroadside.origin: synthetic fixed-pool cycle stress; excluded from natural gameplay evidence

entityEffects.measurement: inclusive JSR-to-RTS cycles from executed linked release bytes

destructibleDebris.measurement: linked target dispatch versus the unchanged enemy-only entry

enemyBreakupEffects.measurement: linked release Raider death with no character-effect allocation

replay.input: release FIRE for one frame, then deterministic held-FIRE neutral/sweep/evasive joystick policies

limitations: The legal-heavy result is the maximum of bounded deterministic replays, not a proof over every possible input history.
CPU counts execute the linked NMOS 6502 bytes with DMA disabled for before/after comparison.
